teaser.en: Mushrooms farmed by termites: nkuvi push up from the nest after rain, and the Digo know at least three kinds.
teaser.sw: Uyoga unaolimwa na mchwa: nkuvi huchipuka kutoka kwenye kichuguu baada ya mvua, na Wadigo wanajua angalau aina tatu.
teaser.dg: *Uoga* unaorimwa ni malutswa: nkuvi zinatuluka kula nyumba za malutswa bada ya mvula, na Adigo anamanya aina tahu au zaidi.

summary.en: Nkuvi are termite mushrooms, Termitomyces, which grow from the fungus gardens inside termite nests. The Digo name several kinds by their size and where they grow.
summary.sw: Nkuvi ni uyoga wa mchwa, *Termitomyces*, unaoota kutoka kwenye bustani za kuvu ndani ya vichuguu vya mchwa. Wadigo huzipa majina aina kadhaa kulingana na ukubwa wake na mahali zinapoota.
summary.dg: Nkuvi ni *uoga* wa malutswa, Termitomyces, unaomera kula minda ya *uoga* iriyo ndani ya nyumba za malutswa. Adigo anaiha aina nyinji kulunga ukulu wao na phatu zinaphomera.

about.en:
*Nkuvi* are termite mushrooms. Underground, fungus-growing termites tend gardens of this fungus inside their nests. After good rains it sends up mushrooms with a long, tough 'root' that runs down into the nest, a stout stem, and a cap that often has a pointed nipple at the centre and splits at the edge as it opens.

The Digo recognise several folk kinds: *nkuvi mdide*, the small *nkuvi*; *nkuvi wa mdani*, the farmland *nkuvi*; and *nkuvi wa mirihini*, the *Brachystegia* woodland *nkuvi*. Pakia found each to be a different *Termitomyces* species.
about.sw:
*Nkuvi* ni uyoga wa mchwa. Chini ya ardhi, mchwa wanaolima kuvu hutunza bustani za kuvu hiki ndani ya viota vyao. Baada ya mvua nzuri, huchipuza uyoga wenye 'mzizi' mrefu mgumu unaoshuka hadi ndani ya kiota, shina nene, na kofia ambayo mara nyingi ina chuchu iliyochongoka katikati na hupasuka pembezoni inapofunguka.

Wadigo wanatambua aina kadhaa za kienyeji: *nkuvi mdide*, *nkuvi* mdogo; *nkuvi wa mdani*, *nkuvi* wa shambani; na *nkuvi wa mirihini*, *nkuvi* wa msitu wa *Brachystegia*. Pakia aligundua kuwa kila mmoja ni spishi tofauti ya *Termitomyces*.
about.dg:
*Nkuvi* ni *uoga* wa malutswa. Tsini, malutswa anarima *uoga* hinyu ndani ya nyumba zao, dza munda. Bada ya mvula nono, unatuluka *uoga* wenye 'muzi' mure na mgumu unaotserera hadi ndani ya nyumba ya malutswa, *muhi wa uoga* mpana, na kofiya ambayo mara nyinji ina ntsa dide kahi-kahi, na inaahuka kanda-kandaye ichivuguka.

Adigo anamanya aina nyinji za chienyeji: *nkuvi mdide*, ambaye ni mdide; *nkuvi wa mdani*, wa mindani; na *nkuvi wa mirihini*, wa kahi ya mihi ya *Brachystegia*. Pakia waona kukala chila mmwenga ni aina ya tafwauti ya *Termitomyces*.

where.en: They appear on and around termite mounds (*tsuluni*), in farmland (*mdani*) and in *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), the three mushroom habitats that Digo collectors recognise.
where.sw: Huibuka juu na kuzunguka vichuguu (*tsuluni*), mashambani (*mdani*) na katika msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), makazi matatu ya uyoga yanayotambuliwa na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo.
where.dg: Zinatuluka dzulu na kanda-kanda ya tsulu (*tsuluni*), mindani (*mdani*) na kahi ya mihi ya *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*): phatu phahahu ambapho Adigo anaotsola *uoga* anaphamanya dza makalo ga *uoga*.

uses.en: Local people collect and eat them. Across Africa, termite mushrooms are among the most prized of all wild foods. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Wenyeji huukusanya na kuula. Kote barani Afrika, uyoga wa mchwa ni miongoni mwa vyakula vya porini vinavyothaminiwa zaidi. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Atu a hipha nkuzitsola na kuzirya. Afrika yosi, *uoga* wa malutswa ni kahi ya vyakurya vya weruni vinavyomendzwa zaidi. *Uoga* wa weruni usiriwe ela umanywe kpwandza ni mutu wa hipha mwenye marifwa manji.

culture.en: *Nkuvi* is one of only two mushroom 'folk genera' in Digo, alongside *nimakoba*: a name with several named kinds beneath it. Collectors pick young mushrooms with the cap still closed (*fundula*), as open caps are often worm-ridden.
culture.sw: *Nkuvi* ni mojawapo ya 'jenasi za kienyeji' mbili tu za uyoga katika Kidigo, pamoja na *nimakoba*: jina lenye aina kadhaa zenye majina chini yake. Wakusanyaji huchuma uyoga mchanga ambao kofia bado imefunga (*fundula*), kwa kuwa kofia zilizofunguka mara nyingi zimejaa funza.
culture.dg: *Nkuvi* ni kundi mwenga kahi ya makundi mairi tu ga *uoga* ga chienyeji (*folk genera*) kpwa Chidigo, phamwenga na *nimakoba*: dzina renye aina nyinji zenye madzina photsire. Atu anaotsola *uoga* anatsambula *uoga* uchiri mphya, ambao kofiyaye taidzangbwevuguka (*fundula*), kpwa sababu kofiya ziriyovuguka mara nyinji zina minyololo.

names.en: Pakia records *nkuvi*, also written *N'kuvi*; its meaning is not explained. Its *N-* prefix is one Pakia reads as carrying a 'female' sense. The meaty *choga nyama* is another *Termitomyces*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nkuvi*, pia huandikwa *N'kuvi*; maana yake haielezwi. Pakia anakisoma kiambishi chake *N-* kuwa kinabeba maana ya 'kike'. *Choga nyama*, wenye nyama nyingi, ni *Termitomyces* mwingine.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nkuvi*, piya inaandikpwa *N'kuvi*; Pakia kalavya manage. Pakia anaona kukala *N-* ya mwandzoni ina mana ya 'chichetu'. *Choga nyama*, wenye nyama nyinji, ni *Termitomyces* yanjina.

reason.sw: Brachystegia, ambapo aina moja ya nkuvi huota
reason.dg: Brachystegia, ambako aina mwenga ya nkuvi inamera

reason.en: the other Digo mushroom folk genus
reason.sw: jenasi nyingine ya kienyeji ya uyoga wa Kidigo
reason.dg: kundi ranjina ra *uoga* ra chienyeji ra Chidigo
